source: 01 · [Name] and the Lost Dinosaur Egg — FINAL CHECK (v2).docx
back_blurb: One morning in the garden, [Name] digs up a big speckled egg. Out pops Pip, a baby dinosaur a long way from home. Over ferns, across a river and through the rain, [Name] helps Pip find the way back to a very big mum.
honesty_line: Illustrated from [Name]'s photo and checked by a person before print.
outfit: teal jumper, navy trousers, rust wellies
cover_art: [Name] at the gap in the hedge at the bottom of a UK terrace back garden, Pip held in [their] arms against the chest (beside the child's face — not on the shoulders or back), giant ferns glowing beyond the hedge; both faces large, front-on and level with each other. Bright morning light.

title_page.spot: the speckled egg half-dug in garden soil, a child's spade beside it. No child on this page.

anchor.description: Pip: cat-sized, round body, sage-green with butter-yellow speckles, cream tummy, three soft rounded back spikes, short tail, large dark eyes; lock on spread 2. Egg (spread 1) same speckles; curly shell (spreads 13-14) oat and butter, pearly.

must_not_show: the child crying or in danger

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: Baby dinosaur, small as a cat next to a child's outline for scale. Round body, sage-green with butter-yellow speckles down the back, cream tummy, three soft rounded back spikes, short tail, large dark eyes. Neutral standing pose. Front view and side view on a plain blank background.

characters.name: Pip's mum
characters.description: Pip's mum: same colours and speckles as Pip (sage-green, butter-yellow speckles, cream tummy), house-sized but rounded and gentle; no teeth or claws. Soft kind eyes. Neutral standing pose. Front view and side view on a plain blank background. Show a small child's outline for scale.

characters.name: Speckled egg
characters.description: Huge dinosaur breakfast egg, round, soft oat-cream shell covered in the same butter-yellow speckles as Pip. Intact whole egg for the dig (not cracked). Child's garden scale — larger than a football. Two clear views on a plain blank background. No child, no Pip, no scenery.

characters.name: Curly shell
characters.description: Small keepsake curly shell Pip gives as a thank-you: oat and butter colours, pearly soft sheen (a shine, not a magic glow), spiral/curly shape that fits in a child's palm. Two clear views on a plain blank background. No child, no Pip, no scenery.

spreads.text: Dig, dig, dig goes [Name]'s spade at the bottom of the garden. Clunk! It hits something big. Something round. Something speckled all over, like a giant's breakfast egg. [Name] brushes away the soil. "It's an egg!"
spreads.setting: Bottom of the back garden of a UK terrace, bright morning; shed, swing and washing line behind; freshly dug soil.
spreads.art: Bright morning. [Name] kneels at the dig, spade in hand, brushing soil off a huge speckled egg; face lit with surprise. Shed, swing and washing line visible behind.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Open sky over the right-hand page — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: The egg goes wibble. The egg goes wobble. Crick… crack… CRUNCH! Out pops a baby dinosaur, small as a cat, with speckles all the way down. "Pip!" squeaks the baby dinosaur. "Pip, pip!" "Hello, Pip," says [Name].
spreads.setting: Bottom of the back garden of a UK terrace, bright morning; shed, swing and washing line behind; freshly dug soil.
spreads.art: Bright morning at the dig. The speckled egg is split open; Pip sits in the shell halves, blinking. [Name] crouches close, one hand held out, smiling. Shed, swing and washing line behind.
spreads.anchor: Pip, first full view. Lock the design here
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper left: hedge and sky — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Pip sniffs the grass. Pip sniffs the shed. Pip sniffs [Name]'s wellies. But there is no nest here, and no dinosaur mum. Pip's chin begins to wobble. [Name] kneels down. "Don't worry, Pip. I'll help you find your way home."
spreads.setting: Bottom of the back garden of a UK terrace, bright morning; shed, swing and washing line behind; freshly dug soil.
spreads.art: Bright morning on the lawn by the dig. Pip sniffs [Name]'s wellie, chin wobbling; [Name] kneels at Pip's level, one hand gently on Pip's back. Shed, swing and washing line behind.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Lawn, lower right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Pip sniffs the air, then points that nose at the hedge. Behind it, where the garden usually stops, giant ferns sway, tall as houses. "Back by teatime!" [Name] calls to the kitchen window. Then the two of them squeeze through the gap.
spreads.setting: Bottom of the back garden of a UK terrace at the hedge gap, bright morning; kitchen window of the house behind; giant ferns glowing beyond the hedge.
spreads.art: Bright morning. A gap in the hedge glows with green light; giant ferns beyond. [Name] waves back towards the kitchen window, where a grown-up's hand waves back (hand only, no face). Pip points at the gap.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky above the house, left-hand page — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Bump! A fallen log lies across the path, far too high for little dinosaur legs. Pip jumps and slides down. Flump. [Name] has an idea. One flat stone, two flat stones, three flat stones, piled up like a step. Up goes Pip. Over goes Pip.
spreads.setting: Fern forest path beyond the garden hedge, warm green daylight; mossy fallen log across the path.
spreads.art: Warm green light under giant ferns. [Name] places the third flat stone on a small pile against a mossy log; Pip is mid-climb, one foot on the step.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Pale fern canopy, top right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: By the river, Pip sits down with a hungry rumble. [Name] finds two biscuits in [their] pocket. "One for you, and one for me." Crunch, crunch, crunch. Pip's tail begins to wag, and off they go again.
spreads.setting: Grassy riverbank beside a shallow sparkling river, warm daytime light; reeds and soft green banks.
spreads.art: Warm daytime. [Name] sits cross-legged on the bank holding out a biscuit; Pip, sitting opposite, takes the other. Crumbs, wagging tail. Shallow calm water beside them.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Calm water, lower left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: The river is wide and splashy. "How do we get across?" wonders [Name]. Then a long, long neck rises out of the reeds. A gentle giant lays it over the water like a bridge. "Thank you!" calls [Name], and over they tiptoe, one careful step at a time.
spreads.setting: Wide shallow sparkling river with reed beds, warm daytime light; far bank visible under open sky.
spreads.art: Warm daytime. A gentle long-necked dinosaur (soft grey-blue, eyes kind) lays its neck across the water like a bridge. [Name] tiptoes along it, arms out for balance; Pip follows. Water stays low and calm.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky over the far bank, top half of the right page — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: On the other side, Pip's little legs go slower… and slower… and stop. Pip gives an enormous yawn. "Up you come," says [Name], and lifts Pip onto [their] back. Pip is heavier than a bag of shopping. Step, step, step.
spreads.setting: Path through tall grass on the far side of the river, warm late-afternoon light; open sky above.
spreads.art: Warm late-afternoon light. [Name] walks forward on the grassy path carrying Pip piggyback, Pip's chin on [Name]'s shoulder, eyes half closed. [Name] looks determined, cheeks a little puffed. Face fully visible.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky, upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Pitter. Patter. Then a grey cloud tips out a whole bucket of rain. Pip wriggles down and scampers off, nose first, to the biggest leaf of all. Underneath, it's dry. [Name] hums the bedtime song from home, and Pip snuggles close.
spreads.setting: Fern path under a huge leaf during light rain; grey-pale sky; wet foliage; nothing dark or stormy.
spreads.art: Light rain. Under the huge leaf Pip has found, [Name] sits humming, eyes soft; Pip snuggles close, nose up. Raindrops bounce on the leaf.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Grey-pale rain sky, top left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: When the rain stops, the path splits three ways. Which way now? [Name] isn't sure. But Pip sniffs… and sniffs… and runs to a footprint so big that [Name] can stand in it with both wellies. Three round toes. It smells like home.
spreads.setting: Fern path after light rain where the path splits three ways; wet ground, clearing sky, drips on leaves.
spreads.art: After the rain, clearing sky. The wet path splits three ways through the ferns. Pip, nose to the ground, has found a giant three-toed footprint; [Name] stands in it with both wellies, laughing.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Clear sky, upper half of the right page — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Past the last ferns is a nest as wide as a paddling pool. Beside it stands the biggest dinosaur [Name] has ever seen, speckled all down her back, just like Pip. "Pip!" she calls, in a voice as deep and soft as a drum. "Pip, pip!" squeaks Pip, and runs.
spreads.setting: Fern-edge clearing with a nest as wide as a paddling pool, soft clear daylight after rain.
spreads.art: Soft clear daylight. Pip's mum stands beside the nest, looking down with warm eyes. Pip runs to her; [Name] watches, smiling, from the ferns. Keep the scale gentle: low angle but no looming.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Open sky between mum's head and the ferns — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Pip's mum looks at [Name] for a long moment. Then she lowers her great head, slowly, gently, all the way down, until her nose is right next to [Name]. [Name] reaches out and strokes it. It is warm and a little bit bumpy. That is a dinosaur thank-you.
spreads.setting: Fern-edge clearing with a nest as wide as a paddling pool, soft clear daylight after rain.
spreads.art: Soft calm daylight, close framing. Pip's mum has lowered her head to [Name]'s height; [Name] strokes her nose with one hand. Pip peeks from under her chin. Nest and ferns softly behind.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Mum's back and sky, top left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Pip drops a small curly shell into [Name]'s hand. "Pip," says Pip. That means thank you. Then Pip's mum carries [Name] home, five giant steps to the hedge. She lowers her long neck, and whoosh! [Name] slides down onto the lawn.
spreads.setting: Arrival at the hedge and lawn of the UK terrace back garden, late-day light; washing line and shed beyond the lawn.
spreads.art: Late-day light, close framing at the hedge. Pip's mum has lowered her long neck to the lawn and [Name] slides down the last bit, feet almost on the grass, curly shell held up in one hand, face front and fully visible. Pip peeks over mum's back, waving. Show the arrival only, never a wide shot of the ride. One child figure only.
spreads.anchor: Pip; the curly shell first appears
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky over the hedge, top right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Back in the garden it is nearly teatime, and the washing is still flapping on the line. That night, the curly shell shines on [Name]'s windowsill. Somewhere past the hedge, a little dinosaur is snuggling down too. "Goodnight, Pip," whispers [Name].
spreads.setting: [Name]'s bedroom at night; moonlight on the windowsill; through the window, moonlit garden with washing line and hedge.
spreads.art: Night. [Name] tucked in bed, eyes closing with a smile. The curly shell shines on the windowsill in the moonlight (a shine, not a magic glow); through the window, moonlit garden with the washing line and the hedge. A grown-up's hand on the duvet, optional. One child figure only.
spreads.calm_zone_note: Night sky through the window, upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

parent_spread.you_could_say: "Pip had a good nose, and you had good ideas. Together you found the way."
parent_spread.try_together: "What would you have packed for Pip?"
parent_spread.in_real_life: Next time it rains, look together for a leaf big enough to be a dinosaur umbrella.
parent_spread.read_it_again: Read it a few nights in a row, and again whenever [Name] asks.

parent_art: Small spot: Pip asleep in the nest clearing with the curly shell beside him, soft quiet light.
